attchmntText: Symbiotec Pharmalab Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: Symbiotec Pharmalab Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 FY27 earnings conference call with the BSE and NSE. The call was held on November 06, 2026. Consolidated revenue for Q2 FY27 was INR280 crores, a 43% year-on-year increase. H1 FY27 revenue grew 25%. Reported EBITDA grew 88% in Q2 and 29% in H1. The company recognized INR53 crores in milestone revenue from its complex injectable business. API business revenue grew 16% in Q2 and 11% in H1. The company signed a long-term agreement for dual-chamber vials with a US partner. It also signed a manufacturing agreement with a Europe-based alternate protein company. A 10-year take-or-pay contract with a US alternate protein company expects commercial batches in Q1 FY28. A 5-year contract for insulin drug substance is expected to commence sales mid-FY28. The company maintains guidance for approximately 20% revenue growth and 25% EBITDA growth for the current fiscal year.

attchmntText: Symbiotec Pharmalab Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Symbiotec Pharmalab Limited has intimated the schedule for investor meetings under SEBI regulations. Company officials will attend the Avendus Spark Conference on 16th November 2026 from 11:00 AM to 05:00 PM. The event is hosted by Avendus Spark at the Grand Hyatt in Mumbai. The meetings will include group and one-on-one interactions. Discussions will be based solely on publicly available information. No unpublished price sensitive information is intended to be discussed. The company notes that changes may occur due to exigencies. This information is filed with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd.
